request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into an ice-age war longship: the pale hull becomes dark brown-grey hide over wood, colour #493736 with #2d2b2b shadows, with a row of round shields of clear ice-blue ice along the side; the grey tower becomes a hide tent; a big ice-blue crystal figurehead on the bow; the red sails become sails of shaggy warm white fur, colour #e3d5b7 shaded warm taupe #8c7667, never blue-grey. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
